title: Plasma Sphere Surreal
description: A vintage plasma globe sits on a wooden table, its transparent sphere filled with branching electric arcs in bright blue, pink, and orange. Inside the globe, a small silhouetted lighthouse emits a white beam, surrounded by floating corn cobs, green leaves, pills, and abstract mechanical elements against a dark background.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal painting of an antique plasma globe on a wooden table. Inside the glowing glass sphere, a small black lighthouse stands at the center emitting a bright beam of light, surrounded by floating corn cobs, green leaves, scattered pills, and mechanical parts. Vibrant blue, pink, and orange electrical plasma arcs branch across the interior. Dramatic lighting with reflections on the glass, dark moody background, painted in a realistic yet fantastical style.
